title: Replacing a Roof in Tomball
description: A roof replacement in Tomball is a tear-off, a look at the deck, and a dry-in before the new shingles go on. Here is what that day includes.
html:
A Tomball replacement is the same job we do across northwest Houston. The old roof comes off, the deck gets a look, and nothing new goes on a wet or soft board.

What the day includes

We tear off to the deck. A second layer already on the house comes off with the first. A third layer is a bad idea in this heat, and a lot of cities will not allow it. Soft plywood or rotted boards get replaced before the underlayment goes down. That conversation is in soft decking on a tear-off. The sheet under the shingles is the water barrier for the years the shingles are shedding granules. That is underlayment under Texas shingles.

Once the weather holds and the materials are on site, a typical house is one to three days: tear-off, dry-in, and install. The day-by-day version for Tomball, Cypress, and The Woodlands is the suburb replacement timeline. Permits depend on the city. Start with when a Houston roof needs a permit, and we will say what your address actually needs.
